Population increased in Newport

The estimated population of Newport in 2024 was 167,899 usual residents, a rise of 1.7% since 2023.

This meant that Newport's rate of population change placed it among the 20 percent fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Newport increased by 5.1%.

Over this slightly longer period, Newport was also among the 20% fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Newport

The average (median) age stayed at 38.5 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Newport has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Newport is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Newport's population of 167,899 usual residents was made up of:

  • 33,978 people aged 0 to 15 years, (20.2%)
  • 105,673 people aged 16 to 64 years, (62.9%)
  • 28,248 people aged 65 years and over, (16.8%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Newport has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 65 years and over (16.8% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Newport, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Newport
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Newport, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 332 people (0.2%). In total, there were 1,903 births and 1,571 deaths in Newport.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 330 (0.2%). There were 6,631 people entering the area and 6,301 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Newport's population of 2,121 (1.3%) as a result of 2,959 people entering the area and 838 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Newport was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Newport in mid-2023 is 165,112.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 1,059 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 425 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 1,484 people.
